artifacts.summary: Reproduces the validate-state.sh failure against specs/archive/state.json, identifies a false-PASS failure mode in Checks 5/6/7 (jq error swallowed into zero findings), documents the archive's real shape (archived_projects/completed_projects, no abandoned_projects writer, 24 live cross-array duplicate project_numbers, an orphan_archived off-enum status), pins the literal /task --abandon write shape (completed_projects entry with status=abandoned and an 'abandoned' timestamp key), and recommends an explicit --archive mode with its own advisory-first check set plus concrete test fixtures.

memory_candidates.content: validate-state.sh's per-entry checks (status enum, project_number numeric, task_type non-empty) are implemented as `while read` loops fed by jq pipelines over `.active_projects[]` with no `// []` guard. When the input JSON lacks that key (e.g. an archive-shaped state file), jq raises a runtime error, the pipeline emits zero lines, and the loop body never runs -- which the script's zero-bad-count logic reads as 'nothing wrong' rather than 'could not check', producing a false PASS. Any new mode validating a differently-shaped state file must route through its own jq expressions keyed on the correct top-level fields rather than falling through to these active-mode checks.

specs/archive/state.json's real top-level shape is {archived_projects, completed_projects} only -- abandoned_projects is dead vocabulary tolerated via `// []` guards in validate-state.sh but has no live writer anywhere in agent-system/extensions/. /task --abandon's own archive insert lands in completed_projects with status='abandoned' and a timestamp field named 'abandoned' (not archived_at) -- a third shape distinct from skill-todo's two archived_projects/completed_projects insert sites which both use archived_at. A measured live count found 24 project_number values present in both archived_projects and completed_projects simultaneously, plus an off-enum status value 'orphan_archived' -- both are pre-existing historical reconciliation noise, not new defects, but mean any new duplicate/status check over the archive must start WARN/advisory, not FAIL, to avoid immediately regressing against real data.
